newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Deelkraal, Elandsrand shares jump.
newsitem.headline: Deelkraal, Elandsrand shares jump.

text.p: Shares in Deelkraal Gold Mining Co Ltd and Elandsrand Gold Mining Co Ltd jumped on Tuesday after news of a joint media conference called by their respective managers Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd and Anglo American Corp of South Africa.
An Anglo spokeswoman told Reuters the 1400 GMT conference concerned Deelkraal's future.

Deelkraal, trading most of the day five cents up at 350 cents in small volume, jumped another 25 cents to 375 cents, swelling volumes to 90,400 shares shortly after the conference was announced. Elandsrand shares gained 130 cents to 21.30 rand in thin volume of 2,600.
Deelkraal and Elandsrand have been in talks since last August over a possible tie-up.
